notes: Monthly terrestrial water storage anomaly (equivalent water height, cm) relative to the 2004.0-2009.999 mean, 0.5 deg grid of ~3 deg equal-area mascons (CRI-filtered). Very coarse: apply the scale factors/land mask per the product docs; not a kilometre-scale aquifer measure. Gap months (e.g. GRACE to GRACE-FO 2017-2018) are absent, not zero.
